title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 6th Proof The Testimony Of The Purified Ones Scholars And Sages

questions.question: Who is being described as teaching people sacred truths in this passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What kind of people are mentioned as giving support for his truthfulness?
questions.answer: Very sincere, careful scholars and faithful wise people.

questions.question: How many of these scholars and sages are described?
questions.answer: There are millions of them.

questions.question: What did these scholars and sages reach through his teaching?
questions.answer: They reached the highest level of learning.

questions.question: What is surprising about his background in this passage?
questions.answer: He did not learn by reading and writing like other teachers.

questions.question: Besides teaching sacred truths, what two things does the passage say he brought forth?
questions.answer: Great branches of knowledge and God-given understanding.

questions.question: What main belief do these scholars strongly prove together?
questions.answer: They prove that Allah is One.

questions.question: Why is Allah’s oneness important in this passage?
questions.answer: It is described as the base of his mission.

questions.question: What else do the scholars and sages testify to besides Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: They testify that the Prophet is truthful and that his words are true.

questions.question: How united are these scholars in their testimony?
questions.answer: They agree together without disagreement.

questions.question: How strong is their evidence described to be?
questions.answer: It is described as very strong and very clear.

questions.question: What comparison is used to show how clear this proof is?
questions.answer: It is compared to bright daylight.

questions.question: What work is named at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: How is the Risale-i Nur described in relation to his truthfulness?
questions.answer: Its one hundred parts are presented as a proof of his truthfulness.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: Learned and sincere scholars strongly confirm both Allah’s oneness and the truthfulness of the Prophet.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of character do the scholars and sages have?
questions.answer: They are pure in intention, honest, and very careful.

questions.question: Through what did they gain their high learning?
questions.answer: They gained it through the teachings and instruction connected to the Prophet.

questions.question: What does the passage say he brought to people?
questions.answer: He brought sacred truths.

questions.question: Even though he was unlettered, what does the passage say he produced?
questions.answer: He produced great knowledge and discovered divine truths.

questions.question: What foundational belief of Islam do the scholars prove?
questions.answer: They prove the unity of Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage call that belief in relation to his mission?
questions.answer: It calls it the foundation of his mission.

questions.question: What do the scholars say about the Prophet himself?
questions.answer: They say he is truthful and a supreme teacher and master.

questions.question: What do they say about his speech?
questions.answer: They say his words are true.

questions.question: Is their witness shown as weak, mixed, or strong?
questions.answer: It is shown as strong.

questions.question: What phrase shows they are in full agreement?
questions.answer: The passage says they testify all together in one agreement.

questions.question: Why does the passage compare this proof to daylight?
questions.answer: Because it wants to show that the proof is plain and easy to recognize.

questions.question: What book is mentioned as another proof?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: How much of that book is said to support his truthfulness?
questions.answer: All one hundred parts of it.

questions.question: Give a short summary of the passage.
questions.answer: Many highly trained Muslim scholars agree that the Prophet taught divine truth, proves Allah’s oneness, and is completely truthful.

questions.question: What group is highlighted in this passage as witnesses?
questions.answer: A huge number of sincere scholars and believing sages.

questions.question: What makes these scholars trustworthy in the passage?
questions.answer: They are described as purified, sincere, careful, and highly learned.

questions.question: What did they study under?
questions.answer: They studied the sacred truths taught by the Prophet.

questions.question: What level did they reach in learning?
questions.answer: They reached the highest rank of learning.

questions.question: What contrast does the passage make about the Prophet?
questions.answer: It says he was unlettered, yet he brought very high knowledge.

questions.question: What two kinds of knowledge are connected to him in the passage?
questions.answer: Advanced sciences and divine knowledge.

questions.question: What do these scholars prove first?
questions.answer: They prove the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: What do they testify about the Prophet after that?
questions.answer: They testify that he is true and that what he says is true.

questions.question: Which is presented as the base of his mission: miracles, wealth, or Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What does the phrase “strongest proofs” tell us about their evidence?
questions.answer: It tells us their evidence is very powerful and convincing.

questions.question: What does the passage call the Prophet to show his high position as a teacher?
questions.answer: It calls him the greatest teacher and master.

questions.question: What example from later scholarship is added at the end?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur is added as a proof.

questions.question: How is the Risale-i Nur counted in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as having one hundred parts.

questions.question: What is each part of the Risale-i Nur said to do in a general way?
questions.answer: It supports the truthfulness of the Prophet.

questions.question: What conclusion should a reader draw from the whole passage?
questions.answer: The reader should understand that learned believers strongly and clearly support the truth of the Prophet and his message.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of scholars and sages who support the Prophet’s message?
questions.answer: It says there are millions of them.

questions.question: What personal qualities are given for these scholars?
questions.answer: They are cleansed in character, sincere, and careful.

questions.question: What kind of wisdom do the sages have?
questions.answer: They are faithful and wise in a believing way.

questions.question: What helped them reach the highest station of learning?
questions.answer: The teachings and instruction found in the sacred truths brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: What unusual fact is mentioned about the Prophet as a teacher?
questions.answer: He was unlettered.

questions.question: What did he still bring, even without ordinary schooling?
questions.answer: He brought lofty knowledge and discovered divine understanding.

questions.question: What central truth do the scholars affirm with strong evidence?
questions.answer: They affirm that Allah is One.

questions.question: How is that truth connected to the Prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: It is the main base his mission stands on.

questions.question: What do the scholars witness about the Prophet’s character and message?
questions.answer: They witness that he is truthful and that his message is true.

questions.question: What do they witness about his words in particular?
questions.answer: They say his words are reliable and true.

questions.question: What does their unanimity add to the argument?
questions.answer: It shows that many learned people agree on the same truth.

questions.question: What picture is used to explain how clear this proof is?
questions.answer: The picture of bright daytime.

questions.question: What title of a work appears in the final sentence?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What does the final sentence say that work does?
questions.answer: It serves as proof for the Prophet’s truthfulness.

questions.question: If you had to explain this passage in one sentence, what would you say?
questions.answer: It says that countless sincere and learned believers agree that Allah is One and that the Prophet is a completely truthful messenger.

questions.question: In this passage, who are the people giving evidence about the Prophet?
questions.answer: Millions of careful Muslim scholars and faithful wise people.

questions.question: What do their qualities suggest about their testimony?
questions.answer: Their testimony can be trusted because they are sincere and careful.

questions.question: What had these scholars and sages achieved?
questions.answer: They had reached the highest level of learning.

questions.question: What led them to that level?
questions.answer: Learning the sacred truths taught through the Prophet.

questions.question: What does the passage point out about the Prophet’s education?
questions.answer: He was unlettered.

questions.question: Name one thing the scholars prove together.
questions.answer: They prove Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Name a second thing they testify to together.
questions.answer: They testify to the Prophet’s truthfulness.

questions.question: Name a third thing they support in the passage.
questions.answer: They support the truth of his words.

questions.question: What does the passage call Allah’s oneness in relation to the mission?
questions.answer: It is the foundation of the mission.

questions.question: What does calling the Prophet a great master show?
questions.answer: It shows his high rank in teaching and guiding people.

questions.question: What can we infer from the phrase “with the strongest proofs”?
questions.answer: Their reasons are not weak guesses but strong evidence.

questions.question: What object from nature is used to describe the clearness of this proof?
questions.answer: Daylight.

questions.question: Which work is mentioned as supporting this truth?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What is the main message of the passage?
questions.answer: The passage teaches that many top scholars confirm the Prophet’s truth and the truth of tawhid.

questions.question: What large group is described in the target passage?
questions.answer: A very large group of sincere and exact scholars and believing sages.

questions.question: How does the passage describe their spiritual and moral state?
questions.answer: It describes them as purified and sincere.

questions.question: How does the passage describe their carefulness in learning?
questions.answer: It says they are very exact and disciplined.

questions.question: What source helped them become highly learned?
questions.answer: The sacred teachings brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: What is one remarkable thing about the Prophet mentioned here?
questions.answer: He was unlettered.

questions.question: What did he nevertheless bring to people according to the passage?
questions.answer: He brought elevated knowledge and discovered divine truths.

questions.question: What first truth do these scholars prove with one voice?
questions.answer: They prove the unity of Allah.

questions.question: What is that truth said to be for his mission?
questions.answer: It is its foundation.

questions.question: What do they also witness about the Prophet himself?
questions.answer: They witness that he is truthful and a supreme teacher.

questions.question: What do they say about what he spoke?
questions.answer: They say his words are true.

questions.question: What does their agreement show: confusion or certainty?
questions.answer: It shows certainty.

questions.question: Why would the passage mention both scholars and sages instead of only one group?
questions.answer: To show that people of deep learning and deep wisdom both support the same truth.

questions.question: What simile is used for the strength and clearness of this proof?
questions.answer: It is like clear daylight.

questions.question: What later work is included as one proof among these evidences?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What overall lesson does this passage give to the reader?
questions.answer: It teaches that the Prophet’s message is strongly confirmed by many deeply learned and faithful people.
